title: Night Trains
concept:
Three songs written in transit.

Every track on this EP started as a voice memo on a night train — a melody hummed against the window, the rhythm of the rails underneath. The album page is a workspace, not a museum: demos, half-finished lyrics, and the story of where each song came from, updated as the songs grow up.

This is the part of a record nobody usually gets to see.

tracks.title: Last Train Coast
tracks.story: The 23:40 southbound, the one where the carriage lights dim after the second stop. The chorus arrived somewhere between two tunnels and I sang it into my phone with my coat over my head so the other passengers wouldn't hear.
tracks.notes: Chorus is done. Verses still sound like placeholder words — because they are.

tracks.title: Harbour Lights
tracks.story: A city I've only seen from the water. The lights come up one hill at a time, like the town is deciding whether to wake up. This one wants to be a ballad; I keep trying to make it faster and it keeps refusing.

tracks.title: Return Ticket
tracks.story: Written on the way back, which is a different song than the way there. Same chords as track 01, on purpose — coming home should rhyme with leaving.
